The '''Battle of Sepan 8''' was a battle during [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Sepan campaign|campaign]] to end the [[Sepan Civil War]]. After learning that the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] were meeting to negotiate an alliance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Harkov led his forces in an attempt to capture the leaders of both sides.

==Prelude==
Up until this point, the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] had been fighting a 40-year civil war with each other across the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]]. When the Galactic Empire deployed Admiral Harkov to forcefully end the war in an attempt to restore order in the system, the Dimoks and Ripoblus set aside their differences and agreed to form an alliance with each other in an attempt to drive away the Imperial force. They agreed to meet above [[Sepan 8]] in [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttles]]. This possible alliance worried the Imperials, so Harkov was sent to capture the leaders in order to prevent the alliance and in order to blackmail the two factions into ending the war without further objection.

==The battle==
Harkov sent four [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] from Nu Squadron to intercept the Dimok and Ripoblus fleets meeting above Sepan 8. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] flew as Nu 2. Their mission was to disable shuttles ''[[Keydon]]'' and ''[[Phantele]]'' before the meeting could commence. The Imperials first cleared out the Ripoblus [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]s and the Dimok [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] who were patrolling the area. Once this was done, the Imperials attacked the two shuttles and disabled them. Two Imperial [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s from Omega Squadron then hypered into the area to capture the leaders. Gunboats from Tau Squadron arrived to escort the transports.

Desperate to prevent the capture, the Dimoks deployed more squadrons of Z-95s from the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Manus Ferre]]'' to destroy Omega Squadron. The Ripoblus sent in more squadrons of escort shuttles as backup. The Dimoks called in various capital ships, including the Light Calamari Cruiser ''[[Falaricae]]'' to provide additional support. Despite fierce resistance from both factions, Stele and his wingmen decimated the enemy squadrons and Omega Group was able to extract all of the prisoners. The shuttles ''Keydon'' and ''Phantele'' were then destroyed. Stele held off the enemy forces while the transports made off with their prizes. Before leaving, he inspected two Dimok cargo ferries, [[Glaive (cargo ferry)|Glaive]] and [[Godendag]], escorted by [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette]] [[Runka]] that were confirmed to have been carrying Imperial arms. He then destroyed the ferries to prevent them being used in the war.

==Aftermath==
Despite the success of the attack, the prisoners that the Imperials had captured were not in fact the leaders of [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]], but the children of the respective leaders. They were to be exchanged as hostages in order to keep the opposite factions in line as part of a new treaty. This treaty was made to make both sides set aside their differences and join forces to resist against the Imperials. The children were held by the Imperials but may or may not have been sent home following the war's end. The alliance was short-lived as the Imperials broke the system's will to resist after a series of bloody skirmishes left the Dimok and Ripoblus militaries effectively defeated.

Stele's discovery of more Imperial arms among the two factions further added to fears that an Imperial traitor was selling arms to various groups for personal profit. The Imperials were determined to discover who this traitor was, but it was not until after his betrayal that Admiral Harkov revealed his disloyalty to the Empire.

==Behind the scenes==
The conflict is described in the game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. It is Battle 2 Mission 4 in the game. The player takes the role of Maarek Stele who is assigned as one of the Gunboats in Nu Squadron. The player has the option of inspecting the Cargo ferries and modified corvette as part of the secondary objectives. The bonus objectives, which are hidden from the player are to inspect the capital ships.
